title: Willie Geist Is Leaving ‘Morning Joe’ After Nearly 20 Years
text:

Willie Geist Is Leaving ‘Morning Joe’ After Nearly 20 Years
He will take on an expanded role at NBC News, where he has been the host of the Sunday edition of the “Today” show since 2016.
Willie Geist, who has been a host of the “Morning Joe” cable news franchise for nearly two decades, said on Monday that he will leave the show at the end of the year to take on an expanded role with NBC News.
Mr. Geist framed his departure as inevitable, as he had been splitting his work life between two networks: MS NOW, the home of “Morning Joe,” and NBC, where he hosts the Sunday edition of the “Today” show and appears in other capacities on the morning program.
That arrangement was easier to manage when the networks were owned by the same parent company, Comcast, and were both operating out of studios at 30 Rockefeller Plaza in Manhattan. MS NOW, then known as MSNBC, was among the cable channels once part of the NBCUniversal TV empire that were spun off under an arrangement formalized earlier this year.
NBC said on Monday that Mr. Geist had been the only on-air employee working for both NBC News and MS NOW since the separation. “It was never intended to last forever,” Mr. Geist said on Monday’s episode of “Morning Joe.”
He said he was leaving “with a very heavy heart, heavy with memories and experiences and friends and family.”
He also addressed his co-hosts, Joe Scarborough and Mika Brzezinski, with whom he had worked since the show premiered in April 2007. “A run that’s lasted nearly 20 years beside the two of you,” he said, had been “the joy of a lifetime, the job of a lifetime.”
